shared_elements: upright stone monument with rounded top and broader lower body
circular disc/ring motif set centrally on the lower field
division of the surface into an upper zone and a lower zone
horizontal band-like divisions across the lower part
justification: Both are upright stone slabs/blocks whose silhouette narrows to a rounded top and widens below, with an upper field and a lower field carrying a prominent central disc and horizontal band-like divisions — that centred disc is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a dense, flat, tightly interlaced linear composition packed with figures and animals in framed registers, while B is a massive three-dimensional sculpted body with a modelled head and only sparse, blunt low-relief motifs, so the shared traits read as generic rather than a shared scheme.
